services.name: payment-service
services.description: Core payment processing service. Handles all payment transactions including credit card, ACH, and digital wallet payments.

dependencies.description: Primary PostgreSQL 15 instance for all payment transaction storage
Redis cache for idempotency keys and session state
ML-based fraud scoring. Payment proceeds if service unavailable.
Sends payment confirmation emails/SMS via SQS queue

services.name: postgres-primary
services.description: Primary PostgreSQL 15 RDS instance shared by payment-service and order-service
services.note: Total available: 100 connections. payment-service v2.4.2 increased pool to 50, leaving only 50 for other consumers. At full payment-service load (50 connections) + order-service (20) + replica (20) = 90/100 connections. Adding superuser reserved (10) means system can hit hard limit.

services.name: api-gateway
services.description: Kong API Gateway. Routes traffic to upstream services. Handles auth, rate limiting.

services.name: order-service
services.description: Order management service. Creates and tracks customer orders.
